newsitem.title: USA: ITT Industries aims for 10-12 pct growth.
newsitem.headline: ITT Industries aims for 10-12 pct growth.

text.p: ITT Industries Inc aims to grow its annual operating income by 10 to 12 percent through margin expansion and increased sales, said Travis Engen, the company's chairman and chief executive.
In a telephone interview, Engen said he was speaking about the automotive, defense and fluid technology company's overall growth targets.

"We don't expect that from every business every year, Engen said, noting that economic cycles and its own investments in individual units could affect results. "On the whole that's what our target is."
ITT Industries reported 1996 profits of $222.6 million, or $1.85 a share, on sales of $8.72 billion.
Hengen said the company has geographic diversity that buffers economic cycles.
At its automotive division, which accounted for 54 percent of its operating income and $5.5 billion in sales, the company has struck a balance between North American and European sales.
